claims.claim: Registers the handoff command and validates interactive UI, selected model, and goal input.
Delegates generation to the host model registry with abort signaling, disabled cache retention, and a unique session ID.
After the latest compaction, preserves its summary and retained branch entries for handoff context.
With no compaction, preserves every branch entry convertible to a model message for handoff context.
Serializes the resulting branch context and sends it with the requested goal to the configured model.
Reads the current session file for optional parent tracking.
Lets the user edit the generated prompt before opening a replacement session and passes the captured session-file value as the parent-session option.
